claim_one_line: B849's declared citation is CONFIRMED verbatim from the primary source: the Connes-Marcolli-Ramachandran system's symmetry group is the idele class group of K, acting freely and transitively on extremal KMS states, and Gal(K^ab/K) is the maximal abelian quotient of Gal(Kbar/K), so complex conjugation (which does not fix Q(sqrt-3)) is excluded; the conditional RELOCATES to whether the programme's system is BC/CMR-type and over which order.
